field_audits.exact_text: The transition to HumanDriving is placed on the compound Autonomous state with the guard `human_steering_cmd || brake_pressed || in (AutoFinal)`. The specification says the transition to human driving mode occurs when a human steering command or brake press is received while in the AutoFinal sub-state. This has two problems: (1) the transition should originate from the AutoFinal sub-state itself, not from the parent compound state, because it is only valid when the system is in that sub-state; (2) the use of `||` (OR) between all three conditions means the transition would fire on being in AutoFinal alone, with no input event, which is not what the specification intends. The correct model would be a transition from AutoFinal to HumanDriving (or outside) triggered by `human_steering_cmd || brake_pressed`.
